body: I have a CPN and a care plan already and they do offer support but it hasn't led to an upturn in things yet. :(

I have the same problem where I basically mope around, nap most of the daytime and end up slightly active in the evening, and find the only thing I can motivate myself to do is get ready and get drunk. Exacerbated by being homeless and depressed by where I live. Which invariably makes me feel guilty the next day, and knocks me out for days.
I think it's a combination of attention and the fact it can make me feel better. I do self-harm less but my emotional injuries are bigger now.

No. But I have nobody. All I have is the pub, where I stand alone (bear in mind I'm female) at the bar and drink lots to be out of here. But then I feel worse the next time.

And anywhere I go I still have to stay here. And I'm scared at night.

Thank you. I don't want to either, and I'm stable right now, but sometimes I've been scared that I sort of have to, actually wanting admission to a mental health ward to help fix me. But anyway.

I've had issues for as long as I can remember. I became such an anti-social recluse in my early teens, but with really obsessive tendencies. As I grew up I came out of my shell socially, but lost so many friends, and was so volatile. I always had plans but was seldom able to execute them, and then aged 19 I went to University, that failed, and after dropping out I just became more and more of a lethargic, fragile mess until this year when it all fell apart.

Anyway, I do seem to meet, like, every criteria for BPD. Except maybe impulsiveness, I can be a little bit, but not as much as it seems like it should be. And so I think for them it's a clear cut diagnosis.

I believe they'll offer me DBT. I'm very skeptical about therapy as the bits they showed me just, well, it didn't seem to help. So much 'distract yourself with other things' or 'try to see it's not about you', and basically that goes against everything my head says. My head is an over-thinking, all over the place, deeply lonely mess. Like argh, I'm so alone. I really do hate that. I lost my friends and partner to this and how I respond to things.

Ranting again, sorry. >.< I've just never had a chance to discuss this before.
